measurement: The 2026-10-02 Orme reading was 97%. The dashboard flagged it using a fixed 98% threshold. Pin was 97% on the same date.
independent: Cèdre's temperature sensor was replaced on 2026-10-03, outside the contract scope.
finding: On 2 October the Orme dashboard alert is not contractual: 97% is above the applicable 96% threshold.
corrected_finding: On 2 October the Orme dashboard alert is contractual: 97% is below the applicable 97.5% threshold.
unknown: The cause of the availability reading is unknown.
